description.narrative: Bishkek Feminist Initiatives believes that women are the main agents of change in promoting their own rights therefore they work with women's and girls to raise their voice, be an opinion maker and activist for herself. While also encouraging/supporting feminist initiatives by their members or other feminist activists. The grant will support the following specific priorities: - Empowerment. Support/strengthening the capacity of local activists in order to bring the feminist movement to a new level; - Continue to create media products on women's rights and feminism, and online discussion platform for all activists and feminists in the country; - Planting a feminist forest. Continuing tree planting will not only be activist work but also creating a community space where community comes together; - Feminist network: expanding network of the feminist movement for greater reach in the country, holding more events online/offline and video series which will be part of the feminist school.
